Design: A compact isometric scientific modeling platform. On its left, a cluster of 8 separated ocean-blue dots represents unstructured samples. A SINGLE broad apricot curved arrow-ribbon carries the eye from this loose cluster toward the right, where a clearly readable ball-and-stick geometric structure stands: 5 large ivory/blue vertices joined by sparse thick navy triangular edges forming a rigid 3D framework. Not a funnel machine, not a literal chemical molecule; the geometric graph also suggests scientific structure without naming a specific compound.
